result:
Implemented Phase 3 (Transcribe / Speech):

- **`app/assets/sample.wav`** — bundled copy of `spec-assets/sample.wav`, picked up by the vite static-copy config and confirmed present at `<app>.app/app/assets/sample.wav` in the built bundle.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`.
- **`app/services/speech.ts`** — wraps `SFSpeechRecognizer`: authorization status/request mapped to `not-requested`/`granted`/`denied` (denied covers both Denied and Restricted), and `transcribeSample` runs an `SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` against the bundled file with `shouldReportPartialResults = true`, streaming partials via callback and resolving with the final transcript.
- **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — wired to match spec §5.2/§5.3 exactly: status line text, access refresh on `navigatedTo`, button enablement rules, live-updating transcript during `Transcribing…`, and a `Completed in N.N s` line measured wall-clock from tap to final result; errors surface in the status line and re-enable the button.

`ns build ios` succeeds and `vue-tsc --noEmit` reports no type errors.
